## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, format, tests)

## Model changes only

If this changes rates, multipliers, or allocation rules:

- [ ] `src/core/types.ts` spec comment updated
- [ ] README "The cost model" tables updated
